messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 08 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: OKR mid-run: rebaseline, blocker escalation, and QBR asks

Team —

Quick mid-run check. I ran the numbers and flagged the following with owners/asks so we can lock Q3 QBR slides this week. Attached: okr-midrun-summary.pdf and okr-status-slide-deck.pdf.

High-level:
- Serving performance OKR (Latency < 120ms p95): at-risk. Recent model rollout regressed p95 by ~20ms on 2 production routes. Need a short rollback + A/B plan.
- Cost reduction OKR (unit token $): on track only if we accept more aggressive quantization for some workloads — requires validation for quality.
- Dedicated capacity adoption OKR: pipeline moving but we have a gating dependency on a capacity commitment from infra for a reserved pool for two enterprise pilots.

Immediate asks:
1) Vivek — can you confirm whether we can reallocate one 8-GPU cluster to Dedicated pilot by 07/20? If not, please propose alternate timeline. This is the critical path for the dedicated adoption metric.
2) Marcus — we need two focused quantization runs on the LLaMA-like baseline and the 30B variant. Specs in quantization-experiment-specs.md (attached). Can you prioritize and share results in 10 business days?
3) Lauren — can you consolidate the QBR slide set and own the narrative? I’ll hand you the attached deck and the short exec summary.

I propose a quick sync today 3pm PT (30m) to align owners and timeline. If you can’t make it, respond inline with commitments.

Ben
Ben Carter
Head of Product, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
(Attachment: okr-midrun-summary.pdf, okr-status-slide-deck.pdf)

Thanks Ben — high level makes sense. I can own the slides and narrative.

Quick notes inline:
- Rollback + A/B: we should include a short risk slide showing customer impact and rollback plan. Ben, please share the metric slices you want highlighted (routes + tenant IDs).
- For QBR, I’ll consolidate the deck and have a first draft by Friday EOD. I’ll need the finalized numbers and the infra ETA to make the adoption timeline credible.

I’ll join the 3pm sync.

— Lauren

On it. I’ll kick off two experiment branches today:
- A: 8-bit asymmetric quant on the LLaMA-like baseline (latency vs perplexity sweep)
- B: 4-bit mixed-int quant on the 30B variant (quality-focused)

Deliverables and ETA: reproducible experiment notebooks, aggregated quality/latency table, and recommended profile. Expect preliminary results within 7 business days, full analysis within 10. I’ll upload logs to the shared Drive and tag the deck.

Question: which evaluation dataset do you want for the quality regression check? Prod slices or internal eval set? If we run only internal eval we risk missing tenant-specific regressions. Recommend a small prod-slice smoke test once A/B is ready.

Marcus

Senior Applied ML Engineer

- Vivek: provision 8-GPU cluster and pre-stage images — target 2026-07-20 (dependent on Marcus config). (Attachment: dedicated-capacity-plan.xlsx)
- Lauren: consolidate QBR slides and narrative — first draft 2026-07-10, final by 2026-07-22.
- Ben/Laura: prepare a short customer-facing slide for Jordan Systems by 2026-07-18 (to confirm pilot scope for their renewal conversation).

Emma / Jordan Systems — looping you in so you can confirm pilot readiness on your side and whether you want an early demo the week of 7/20. We’ll send a short scope doc once Marcus posts experiment results; the goal is a safe pilot with the dedicated pool.

If anyone needs to renegotiate dates, call it out today so Lauren can adjust the QBR narrative. I’ll update the Drive folder and the HubSpot record (HUBSPOT-12345).
